title: Peek does not work when using separate Explorer processes
author: emipa606
summary: Peek activates only from the first File Explorer process when Windows is configured to launch folder windows in separate processes.
next_action: Reproduce on current Windows with process-separated Explorer windows and trace selected-item discovery for each process.

confidence.rationale: The configuration boundary and affected window order are independently confirmed.

judgment.rationale: The setting-specific behavior was confirmed by another user and a maintainer identified the shell API's process scope as the likely boundary.
evidence: The issue reproduces only with `Launch folder windows in a separate process` enabled.
A second user confirms every Explorer window opened after the first is affected on 0.70.1.
A maintainer states the shell API used by Peek may not work for Explorer windows outside the first process.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on current Windows with process-separated Explorer windows and trace selected-item discovery for each process.

fix_assessment.rationale: The owning shell API failure point must be confirmed on current Explorer before a fix approach is chosen.

issue_context.summary: Peek activates only from the first File Explorer process when Windows is configured to launch folder windows in separate processes.
known_information: The original affected versions are PowerToys 0.70.0 and 0.70.1.
Peek works from the first Explorer window but not later separate-process windows.
No assignee or linked fix is present.
inferences: Peek's selected-item provider may bind to one shell process or automation context and fail to enumerate selections in later Explorer processes.
issue_context.analysis: A process-aware trace can establish whether Peek must enumerate shell windows, rebind automation, or use a different selected-item API.
initial_investigation: Read the full report and both comments.
Confirmed the defect is scoped to Explorer's separate-process option and has no linked closing PR.

actions.label: Reproduce Peek across Explorer processes
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Verify selected-file discovery in separate Explorer processes
prerequisites: Windows File Explorer configured to launch folder windows in a separate process
setup: Restart Explorer or sign out/in after enabling the separate-process setting.
Open the first folder window, then open a second folder window in another process.
steps: Select a file in the first window and invoke Peek.
Select a file in the second window and invoke Peek.
Record Explorer process IDs and whether the selected-item query succeeds for each.
Open a third window and repeat to confirm the ordering pattern.
reproduce.expected_result: Peek opens the selected file from every Explorer process, not only the first.
